# 16_05_2026

- consolidated unfinished sprint backlog into `TODO.md`
- removed the `sprints/` workspace docs in favor of the top-level backlog
- prepared the worktree for a repository cleanup commit
- normalized VPS runner result ownership back to the invoking user after `sudo` runs
- enabled BuildKit cache mounts in the service Dockerfiles to reduce repeated VPS rebuild cost
- added a reusable `.github/skills/gcloud-vm-check/` skill for detailed GCP VM validation
- added a GitHub Actions workflow and bootstrap script to sync and validate a clean VM checkout against the pushed commit SHA
- locked the shared Cargo BuildKit caches after the VPS image builds exposed concurrent unpack races
- removed the VM sync workflow after confirming org policy blocks service account key creation and documented the manual gcloud/SSH path instead
- improved `harness analyze-suite` so missing raw reports now point operators to the exact `run-suite` command they need first
- locked the benchmark spec to fixed workload × controller × named network preset matrices and added a concrete preset-matrix harness config
- extended harness analysis with throughput, delivery latency, jitter, deadline miss, and live age-of-information metrics
- changed `analyze-suite` to preserve partial controller matrices and record skipped runs instead of aborting the whole export on missing raw reports
- added `plot-suite` SVG figure generation, a ratatui `live-demo` replay viewer, and a local all-controller harness config for Windows-safe real data generation
- reused one server endpoint and certificate across harness suite runs, cached replay payloads once per suite, switched internal segment headers to binary, and skipped transport reruns when raw reports were already fresh
- made the `demo-client` CLI accept snake_case controller names so VPS matrix configs and shell runners can pass `new_reno` and `amc_preview` directly
- fixed the VPS docker-compose path to forward the configured controller into `demo-client` so matrix raw reports stop silently defaulting to `cubic`
